title: Reading Drill — Planning space for folded bicycles — Preparing a second trial
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Planning space for folded bicycles — Preparing a second trial
passages.body:
**A** In Elmbrook, work on folded bicycles blocking a station side door had already produced a small collection of measurements at peak times. The station operations team used this material to plan a second trial. The first report contained several different figures, but for the second trial the group agreed to publish one main outcome: usable exit width.

**B** The group kept a line of narrow bays for the new trial, which was planned to run for ten weeks. Volunteers were shown a sample record before starting. They were also asked to describe anything unusual in a separate note, so later readers could tell the difference between an ordinary value and one taken during a disruption.

**C** The trial design stated that people waiting with suitcases should be recorded even when everything else appeared normal. If this information was missing, the team would leave the field blank rather than infer an answer. It would publish a provisional finding and label it clearly if too few readings were available for a reliable result.
